$comment: Cross-language contract for cairn-plot's cross-face string enums (colormaps, HDR tone-map operators, public compare-kernel modes) AND the shared builder-name set (the composable builders both faces expose). This ONE file is the canonical set; the TS sources are pinned to it by ui/src/lib/cairn-plot/contracts.test.ts + ui/src/lib/cairn-plot/builder/builders.test.ts and the Python side by tests/test_contracts.py. To change a set, edit this file AND both language sources — a single edit on either side fails its guard. Order is documentation only; every guard compares as a set.
